Mushroom thoughts
I feel like an actor that has gone backstage in the story of my life.  I feel like a child and that everything is being experienced for the first time.  Life is beautiful and scary at the same time.  It is like a ride in which everyone shares the same destination; death.  Time is a measurement of life.  I am the product of time.  Many years and countless millennia have passed for me to have existed.  I am the most me I have ever been.  No one will be me nor will they be a replica of me.  Music is the product of movement.  Sound cannot be created without the vibration of objects.  Fuck I am tripping balls.
